description: Get product type definition. product_type is REQUIRED (e.g. PUZZLE, SAFETY_AND_HEALTH, LUGGAGE). By default fetches the JSON Schema server-side and returns allowed enum values per attribute (attribute_enums) + required_attributes — no need to open the S3 link. The schema is personalised for the selected seller: shipping_templates = the seller's shipping templates (modelli di spedizione) as [{id, name}] — use product_type="PRODUCT" to list them. Templates (rates, zones, transit times) can only be created or edited in Seller Central → Shipping settings: SP-API cannot change them, only assign them to SKUs (update_listing shipping_template / bulk_set_shipping_template). attributes=["care_instructions", ...] returns, per attribute, the structure needed for update_listing patches (fields of each item with type/enum/max_length, required fields, example_patch ready to copy) + attributes_missing for names not in this product type (a PATCH on those would fail with 90000900); attribute_names lists every attribute of the schema. Set raw_schema=true for the full schema, include_enums=false to skip the fetch.

account_id.description: ID dell'outpost Amazon (= un seller su uno specifico marketplace; vedi list_clients). Opzionale se il token è legato a un solo outpost.

attributes.description: Attribute names whose structure you need (e.g. ["care_instructions","material"])

name: get_product_types
